units.source_text: 二月初十左右，宫中举行诗会，

en.t: Around the tenth day of the second month, a poetry gathering was held at court,

units.source_text: 匂亲王与薰大将皆出席。

en.t: and Prince Niou and General Kaoru both attended.

units.source_text: 会上演奏适合时令的各种曲调。

en.t: At the gathering, various melodies suited to the season were performed.

units.source_text: 匂亲王唱催马乐“梅枝”，嗓音非常优美。

en.t: Prince Niou sang the saibara song "Umegae," and his voice was exceptionally beautiful.

units.source_text: 此人无论何事都远胜于他人，

en.t: In every respect this man far surpassed others,

units.source_text: 只有一事罪孽深重，便是耽于女色。

en.t: but he had one deeply sinful fault: he was given over to women.

units.source_text: 天上忽然降雪，风势非常猛烈，

en.t: Snow suddenly began to fall from the sky, and the wind blew with great force,

units.source_text: 音乐演奏立刻停止了。

en.t: so the music stopped at once.

units.source_text: 大家都到匂亲王的值宿室来，

en.t: Everyone came to Prince Niou's night-duty chamber,

units.source_text: 吃过酒饭，随意休息。

en.t: and after food and wine, they rested as they pleased.

units.source_text: 薰大将要找一个人说话，

en.t: General Kaoru wanted to find someone to talk with,

units.source_text: 步出檐前，在星光之下隐约望见雪已渐渐积厚。

en.t: so he stepped out beneath the eaves and, by the starlight, dimly saw that the snow had gradually piled up thickly.

units.source_text: 他身上的香气随风四散，

en.t: The fragrance from his person drifted everywhere on the wind,

units.source_text: 真有古歌所谓“春夜何妨暗”之感。

en.t: truly giving the feeling of the old poem's phrase, "What harm if a spring night is dark?"

units.source_text: 他闲诵“绣床铺只袖……今宵盼待劳”的古歌，

en.t: He casually recited the old poem, "On the brocade bed I lay only one sleeve... tonight I grow weary waiting,"

units.source_text: 信口吟出寥寥数句，

en.t: and lightly chanted just a few lines as they came to him,

units.source_text: 态度异常潇洒，意味特别深长。

en.t: with an unusually elegant manner and especially deep feeling.

units.source_text: 匂亲王正欲就寝，听见了他的吟声，

en.t: Prince Niou was just about to go to bed when he heard Kaoru chanting,

units.source_text: 怪他“可吟之歌甚多，何必特选此歌！”

en.t: and wondered suspiciously, "There are so many poems he could chant; why deliberately choose this one?"

units.source_text: 心中非常不快。

en.t: He felt extremely displeased.

units.source_text: 他想：“看来他同宇治那个女子不是泛泛之交。

en.t: He thought, "It seems he and that woman in Uji are no casual acquaintances.

units.source_text: 我以为这女子‘铺只袖’‘独寝’而‘盼待’的，只有我一人。

en.t: I had thought that I alone was the one for whom she 'laid out only one sleeve,' 'slept alone,' and 'waited longingly.'

units.source_text: 岂知他也有同感，真可恨啊！

en.t: Who would have known that he felt the same way too? How hateful!

units.source_text: 这女子抛舍了如此关怀她的一个男子而更热情地爱慕我，

en.t: For this woman to cast aside a man who cares for her so much and love me even more passionately,

units.source_text: 不知是什么缘故？”

en.t: I wonder what the reason could be?"

units.source_text: 他对薰大将吃醋。

en.t: He was jealous of General Kaoru.
